title: Uhrzeit, Tage und Monate
summary: Telling time the everyday way — including the classic halb-sechs trap — plus the days of the week and the months

blocks.title: Tage der Woche und Monate
blocks.body: The week: *Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag*. Say "on Monday" with *am*: *am Montag*. Months work almost like English — *Januar, Februar, März, April, Mai, Juni, Juli, August, September, Oktober, November, Dezember* — and "in March" is simply *im März*. Berliners sometimes say *Sonnabend* instead of *Samstag* for Saturday — same day, local flavor.

blocks.title: Die Uhrzeit: der Trick mit halb
blocks.body: Telling time the everyday way: *Viertel nach* + hour (quarter past) and *Viertel vor* + the **next** hour (quarter to). Now the trap: **halb** + hour means half **to** that hour, not half past the one before it. *halb sechs* = **5:30**, not 6:30! Germans count forward to the next full hour; English counts back from the last one.
blocks.callout: Say it out loud a few times — *halb sechs, halb sechs, halb sechs* — until 5:30 feels automatic.

pairs.note: *halb* always points at the coming hour, not the one just passed.
*vor* = before — already looking at the next hour.

blocks.explain: *halb neun* points forward to nine, so it's half **to** nine — 8:30.

blocks.prompt: Type the German for 5:30 (the everyday way).
blocks.hint: Half TO the next hour, not half past the last one.
blocks.explain: 5:30 = halb sechs — the classic trap, worth repeating until it's automatic.

blocks.scene: Jonas wants to meet up this weekend and you're finding a time that works.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.target: Ey, hast du am Samstag Zeit?
lines.en: Hey, do you have time on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.target: Sagen wir halb sechs, im Park?
lines.en: Let's say five-thirty, at the park?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Halb sechs ist früh, oder? Vielleicht Viertel nach sechs?
lines.en: Five-thirty is early, isn't it? Maybe quarter past six?

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.target: Na ja, Viertel nach sechs, passt!

questions.q: What time do they agree on?
